_note: Extra-hard boss questions drawn by the dragon, keyed by category. Not loaded as a normal category.

animals.q: Which is the only venomous primate, delivering toxin from a gland on its arm?

food.q: Which mother sauce is the base for both hollandaise and béarnaise?
